orchestration: assert pipeline_size=1 pipeline_rank=0 ssm_idx=0 fa_idx=3 and exactly 64 pipeline_layers with the frozen layer-kind pattern
embed inputs once and capture embedding_output
build fa_mask with pinned create_attention_mask(hidden,cache[fa_idx]) and ssm_mask with pinned create_ssm_mask(hidden,cache[ssm_idx]) exactly once per call
for each ordered layer and cache entry choose ssm_mask for GDN or fa_mask for full attention, call the pinned layer, and capture selected post-block decoder outputs
apply the pinned final norm once, capture final_norm_output, then apply the untied pinned lm_head once
evaluate logits selected captures and every cache leaf together, synchronize the default Metal GPU stream, then host-copy snapshots

requirements: parse model.safetensors.index.json with duplicate-key rejection and require every weight_map entry to name a verified shard
parse every safetensors header with bounded lengths; reject duplicate tensor names, invalid dtype/shape, overlapping or out-of-range offsets, and unaccounted trailing payload bytes
require the index tensor-name set to equal the union of shard-header tensor names and require weight_map[name] to equal the unique shard whose header contains name

for every tensor require data-region byte length to equal checked dtype_size*product(shape), and require all declared tensor regions to form an exact nonoverlapping gap-free partition of each shard data payload with no leading inter-tensor or trailing bytes
classify every source tensor exactly once as selected text, loaded-but-unexecuted vision where allowed, or required omission MTP/vision
apply the pinned arm-specific rename and sanitation plan, recording every source-to-runtime mapping exactly once
require instantiated runtime text parameter names, shapes, and dtypes to equal the mapped selected inventory
reject every missing, unexpected, duplicate, unmapped, or randomly initialized text parameter

nested_semantic_rules: every nested field is present exactly once; values obey nested_field_types, with null permitted only for nested_nullable_fields and all strings and arrays otherwise nonempty

cache_inventory is static topology with exactly 128 entries ordered by layer then role: GDN layers where layer mod 4 is 0,1,2 have recurrent_state and conv_history; full-attention layers where layer mod 4 is 3 have K and V; dynamic offsets shapes capacities and allocated bytes are forbidden here and are bound by trace events and payload manifests

per_call_kernel_route_evidence has exactly one entry for each executed call and layer 0..63; GDN layers have non-null gdn_path and conv_path with attention_path null, full-attention layers have non-null attention_path with gdn_path and conv_path null

kernel route layer_kind is gdn iff layer mod 4 is 0,1,2 and full_attention iff layer mod 4 is 3; unexpected_fallback_used is false in every accepted primary-arm record while the selected pure-Torch Transformers route is primary rather than an unexpected fallback

parameter classification is selected_text, loaded_unexecuted_vision, omitted_mtp, or omitted_vision; runtime fields and transform are all null exactly for omitted classifications and all non-null otherwise

parameter transform is identity, rename_only, rename_and_add_one, or rename_and_moveaxis_2_1 and matches the pinned arm sanitizer; every source tensor and runtime parameter participates in exactly one mapping
all byte counters use checked unsigned-64-bit bounds; layers are in 0..63; native and parameter shapes contain only positive JSON integers; all SHA-256 strings are lowercase hex
all paths are canonical absolute paths where host-resolved or canonical relative paths within their bound tree where inventory-relative; URLs are absolute HTTPS or the exact lock-resolved VCS source

effective_forward_routes_and_static_kwargs contains exactly stock and instrumented entries; each records only the frozen signature and static kwargs, dynamic_arguments are exact argument names whose per-call values join trace events and payloads, and route_adapter plus its hash are null exactly for stock

process_inventory contains exactly 13 entries: one input_preparation child with null case and run fields plus twelve model_run children covering every planned run/case pair with matching non-null IDs; every child uses a distinct process_instance_id, exit_code=0, python -B -s -P semantics, the same immutable source identity, and sys.path closed to the receipted environment and stdlib roots

each process_entry.memory_and_swap_before_peak_after is a closed diagnostic object whose authority scope interval and noncomparability fields equal receipt_field_contracts.per_arm_memory_diagnostic_profiles[oracle_id]; before load after load and after execution are boundary readings, peak execution uses the selected accelerator peak API and the maximum sampled host-global swap reading, and the accelerator peak counter is reset immediately after the after-load sample

memory and swap diagnostics are not acceptance metrics and are never compared across arms or hosts; they omit host RSS, CUDA reserved bytes, and untracked driver or OS allocations, while wired_memory_policy records the observed or deliberately selected host policy without implying equivalence

environment_tree_identity uses the canonical real site-packages root, inventories every regular file, assigns every distribution-owned file through its exact RECORD, binds every non-RECORD bootstrap file in bootstrap_inventory_sha256, and requires unclassified_file_count=0, include_system_site_packages=false, and symlinks_and_hardlinks_rejected=true

resolved kernel entries cover model-math code only and use generated_definition_sha256 exactly for in-memory generated kernels and runtime_payload_sha256 exactly when a file-backed runtime payload exists; origin_path and origin_file_sha256 are always required, while dyld shared-cache and OS framework identity belongs to backend_and_device

the effective environment values are PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, plus USE_HUB_KERNELS=NO and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 for Transformers; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is the single receipted device selector

python_executable_and_abi inventories the canonical stdlib root separately and requires stdlib_symlinks_and_hardlinks_rejected=true; every child sys.path entry is a canonical real path under only the receipted stdlib or site-packages roots
start and end are RFC3339 UTC instants and end is not before start; exact_inventory, every link-rejection field, and serial_numbers_omitted are true; unsupported_operation_observed is false

digest_preimages.conversation_and_input_bundle_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON sorted by case_id containing case_id template_arguments_sha256 rendered byte_length rendered_sha256 input_ids_count and input_ids_sha256 for every renderer-success case plus stable rejection code for every renderer-reject case
digest_preimages.raw_payload_inventory_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON array sorted by path containing path byte_length and sha256 for every payload regular file and no other file
digest_preimages.environment_lock_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact selected lock-file bytes
digest_preimages.producer_entrypoint_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact regular-file entrypoint bytes

semantic_rules: all arrays and objects are nonempty, duplicate-free under their natural identity key, closed to unknown fields, and sorted where order has no execution meaning
model_source_revision equals the pinned Qwen checkpoint revision while oracle_implementation_revision and oracle_repository equal the selected arm

parent source_pre_verification source_post_verification and source_tree_identity are byte-equivalent canonical objects with exact inventory true and symlink/hardlink rejection true; every child source identity hash equals that object

backend_and_device.device_identity_sha256 uses the exact domain-separated CUDA-UUID or big-endian Metal-registryID preimage above; the raw identifier, serial numbers, usernames, and hostnames are excluded from the receipt

each parameter entry has nonempty source_tensor source_shape and source_dtype; runtime_name runtime_shape runtime_dtype runtime_device and transform are all null exactly for an omitted classification and are all non-null for selected or loaded-unexecuted classifications

cache parameter package process kernel and payload inventories are mutually consistent with the source manifest trace events payload manifest and effective forward route; parent timestamps contain every child interval
